name: Dardanel Onentas Gida Sanayi A.S.
summary: Dardanel Onentas Gida Sanayi A.S. engages in the seafood business in Turkey and internationally. The company produces and sells canned food, including tuna, salmon, sardines, mackerel, anchovy, and other seafood; frozen food comprising mussels and other seafood; and fish by-products, such as fish meal and oil. Dardanel Onentas Gida Sanayi A.S. was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Çanakkale, Turkey.
